------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Overview

**GradBoostR** is a fast, lightweight machine learning package for R
that implements:

- **Random Forests** (regression + classification)\
- **Gradient Boosting Machines (GBM)**\
- **Neural Networks (NN)** with Armadillo backend

The package is designed for **speed**, **simplicity**, and **clean R
interfaces**, while leveraging optimized C++ code via RcppArmadillo.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

[![pkgdown
site](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-pkgdown-blue.svg)](https://nicjc.github.io/GradBoostR/)

![](reference/figures/GradBoostR.png)

## Installation

### From CRAN (once published)

\`\`\`r install.packages(“GradBoostR”)

# Package index

## Reference

- [`fit_stump()`](https://nicjc.github.io/GradBoostR/reference/fit_stump.md)
  : Fit a decision stump
- [`gradboostr_fit()`](https://nicjc.github.io/GradBoostR/reference/gradboostr_fit.md)
  : Train a GradBoostR model
- [`gradboostr_predict()`](https://nicjc.github.io/GradBoostR/reference/gradboostr_predict.md)
  : Generate predictions from a GradBoostR model
- [`rf_class_predict_prob_fast()`](https://nicjc.github.io/GradBoostR/reference/rf_class_predict_prob_fast.md)
  : Random Forest Classification Probabilities
